groups.title: Tokyo Jujutsu High — Current Students
groups.def: Students enrolled at Tokyo Jujutsu High during the main story, through the Culling Game (not the older generation who already graduated, and not school staff).

groups.title: Cursed Spirits
groups.def: Named cursed spirits — beings born from human negative emotion — as opposed to humans, fiends, or human/curse hybrids.

groups.title: Jujutsu High Staff (Tokyo & Kyoto)
groups.def: The principals, homeroom teachers, in-house doctor, and assistant manager of the two jujutsu schools — their administrative/teaching staff, not field sorcerers who merely collaborate with the schools.

groups.title: Gojo's Student-Era Cohort
groups.def: The four classmates/friends shown together as students in the Hidden Inventory/Premature Death flashback arc.

groups.title: Kyoto Jujutsu High Students
groups.def: Students of Kyoto Jujutsu High shown in the anime, from the Goodwill Event roster onward.

groups.title: The Zenin Clan
groups.def: Sorcerers born into the Zenin family by blood, including those who left or were estranged from it — Toji, who was disowned, and Megumi, who was raised apart from the clan but is its blood heir and later becomes its head. Excludes Mahoraga, a shikigami tied to the clan's inherited technique, not a family member.

groups.title: Culling Game Players
groups.def: Sorcerers forced or recruited into playing the Culling Game.

groups.title: Cursed Tool Users
groups.def: Sorcerers whose fighting style relies on a cursed tool — a weapon imbued with a cursed technique.

groups.title: Civilians Drawn Into the Jujutsu World
groups.def: Ordinary civilians, not trained sorcerers, whose lives become entangled in jujutsu society's events.

groups.title: Reincarnated Sorcerers (Culling Game)
groups.def: Culling Game players who are reincarnated sorcerers revived from centuries in the past, not modern-day recruits.

groups.title: Special Grade Sorcerers
groups.def: Sorcerers who hold the rare Special Grade rank — the highest, reserved for a handful of anomalies.

groups.title: Grade 1 Sorcerers
groups.def: Named sorcerers who hold Grade 1 rank (one step below the rare Special Grade).

groups.title: Curse Users
groups.def: Humans who work with or as cursed spirits against jujutsu society, unaffiliated with either school.

groups.title: Inherited Techniques
groups.def: Sorcerers whose cursed technique was passed down within their family or shared bloodline, rather than manifesting on its own.

groups.title: Vessels
groups.def: Characters whose body serves, or served, as a vessel or host for another being: Riko for the Star Plasma Vessel ritual, Yuji for Sukuna, Angel for an ancient sorcerer's soul, and Megumi when Sukuna seizes control of his body.
